question: Which extraordinary scholar and artist of the 17th century AD composed Bhaamaakalaapam, a dance drama based on Kuchipudi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Siddhendra Yogi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Siddhendra Yogi was an** exceptional scholar and artist **of the 17th century AD who composed **Bhaamaakalaapam**, a dance drama based on Kuchipudi.
 
• The dance form of Kuchipudi saw a revolution during the Bhakti movement between the 11th and 13th centuries.
 
• Siddhendra Yogi covers the principles of the dance of** Natya Shastra**, the **Bible of all Indian classical dance styles**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Siddhendra Yogi, a doyen of the Kuchipudi dance form, was lauded as **Adi Guru.**
 
• ​Kuchipudi is one of the **eight**** classical dance styles **of India.
 
• Kuchipudi is indigenous to the state of **Andhra Pradesh** and differs from the other five classical styles by the **inclusion of singing**.
 
• Kuchipudi is a **dance-drama performance art** that originated in a village of Krishna district of Andhra Pradesh, India.

5d
